title: Label
description: Form label with required marker and colon.

usage.summary: Give a form field a persistent, accessible name.
useWhen: Let users identify a field before entering or selecting its value.
Keep the label visible while the field contains data; a placeholder does not replace it.
Connect htmlFor to the field id and use required to show a required-field marker.

avoidWhen.when: Present prose that does not name a field.
Introduce a page, section or group heading.
